sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Anna Montoya is American Fork City’s Finance Director and Budget Officer. This page collects available records about her role and employment.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: The city’s finance page identifies Montoya as Finance Director. June 2020 council minutes list her as Finance Officer, and June 2026 minutes list her as Finance Director.
